---
title: "Word Frequency & Word Cloud"
subtitle: "Words are not codes, and codes are not themes — use this to spot vocabulary patterns, not to replace coding."
---

```{=html}
<div id="tb-no-project-alert" class="alert alert-warning d-none">
<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i> No active project selected. <a href="projects.html">Go to Projects</a> to create or open one.
</div>

<div id="tb-wf-content" class="d-none">

<div class="alert alert-secondary small">
<i class="bi bi-lightbulb"></i> <strong>Important:</strong> "factory waste", "dirty river" and "smoke" might all be coded as <em>Environmental Pollution</em> — so the coded reference count for a theme can be much higher than the count of any single word. Word frequency is a vocabulary check, not a substitute for coding.
</div>

<div class="tb-panel mb-4">
<div class="tb-panel-header">Scope</div>
<div class="tb-panel-body">
<div class="grid gap-3">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4">
<div class="btn-group-vertical w-100" role="group">
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="wfScope" id="tb-wf-scope-all" value="all" checked>
<label class="btn btn-outline-secondary text-start" for="tb-wf-scope-all">All transcript text</label>
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="wfScope" id="tb-wf-scope-coded" value="coded">
<label class="btn btn-outline-secondary text-start" for="tb-wf-scope-coded">Coded passages only</label>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4" id="tb-wf-theme-wrap" style="display:none;">
<label class="form-label small">Limit to theme(s)</label>
<div id="tb-wf-theme-checks" style="max-height:120px;overflow-y:auto;"></div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4">
<label class="form-label small">Extra stopwords (comma-separated)</label>
<input class="form-control form-control-sm" id="tb-wf-stopwords" placeholder="e.g. village, district">
</div>
</div>
<button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm mt-3" id="tb-wf-apply-btn"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Update</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="grid gap-3 mb-4">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-7">
<div class="tb-panel" style="height:420px;">
<div class="tb-panel-header">Word Cloud <button class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" id="tb-wf-cloud-png" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="tb-panel-body">
<canvas id="tb-wf-cloud" width="700" height="360" style="width:100%;height:100%;"></canvas>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-5">
<div class="tb-panel" style="height:420px;">
<div class="tb-panel-header">
Word Frequency Table
<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="tb-wf-export-btn"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> CSV</button>
</div>
<div class="tb-panel-body">
<table class="table table-sm table-striped">
<thead><tr><th>Word</th><th class="text-end">Count</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="tb-wf-table-body"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  if (window.TB && window.TB.seedDemoIfNeeded) window.TB.seedDemoIfNeeded();
  var TB = window.TB;
  var project = TB.getActiveProject();
  if (!project) { document.getElementById("tb-no-project-alert").classList.remove("d-none"); return; }
  document.getElementById("tb-wf-content").classList.remove("d-none");

  function esc(s) { return TB.escapeHtml(s); }
  var lastResult = [];

  function renderThemeChecks() {
    document.getElementById("tb-wf-theme-checks").innerHTML = project.themes.map(function (t) {
      return '<div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input tb-wf-theme-check" type="checkbox" value="' + t.id + '" id="wfchk-' + t.id + '">' +
        '<label class="form-check-label" for="wfchk-' + t.id + '">' + esc(t.name) + "</label></div>";
    }).join("") || '<p class="text-muted small">No themes yet.</p>';
  }

  function toggleThemeWrap() {
    var coded = document.getElementById("tb-wf-scope-coded").checked;
    document.getElementById("tb-wf-theme-wrap").style.display = coded ? "" : "none";
  }

  function update() {
    var scope = document.querySelector('input[name="wfScope"]:checked').value;
    var themeIds = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll(".tb-wf-theme-check:checked"), function (c) { return c.value; });
    var extra = document.getElementById("tb-wf-stopwords").value.split(",").map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    lastResult = TB.wordFrequency(project, { scope: scope, themeIds: themeIds.length ? themeIds : null, extraStopwords: extra });

    TB.charts.renderWordCloud("tb-wf-cloud", lastResult);

    var body = document.getElementById("tb-wf-table-body");
    body.innerHTML = lastResult.length
      ? lastResult.slice(0, 200).map(function (w) { return "<tr><td>" + esc(w.word) + "</td><td class=\"text-end\">" + w.count + "</td></tr>"; }).join("")
      : '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-muted">No words found for this scope.</td></tr>';
  }

  document.getElementById("tb-wf-apply-btn").addEventListener("click", update);
  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="wfScope"]').forEach(function (r) { r.addEventListener("change", function () { toggleThemeWrap(); update(); }); });
  document.getElementById("tb-wf-export-btn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    TB.exportUtil.exportWordFrequencyCSV(lastResult, TB.exportUtil.slug(project.title) + "-word-frequency");
  });
  document.getElementById("tb-wf-cloud-png").addEventListener("click", function () {
    TB.exportUtil.canvasToPNG("tb-wf-cloud", TB.exportUtil.slug(project.title) + "-word-cloud.png");
  });

  renderThemeChecks();
  toggleThemeWrap();
  update();
});
</script>
```
